title: Pillars of Pain
text:
Walkthrough

You now have to jump across a group of dead trees, above a large spiked pit. Be cautious The stick holding up a part of the tree will break if you jump on it, and you will need to run to the left side to avoid its fall.

The succeeding tree will then fall forward, hence you will have to jump to the next tree. After the spiked tree, you will have to jump over a spiked ball. The final tree is a downward slide where you will proceed to the end of the chapter.
